"''This appeals to you? This doesn't appeal to me, and I live here.|Asajj Ventress and Cort||audio=DoesntAppealToMe.mp3}} During the [[Imperial Era]], an '''astronomical object''' occupied by the [[Galactic Empire]] was home to a [[human]] [[Gender|woman]] named [[Cort]], who ran a [[Cort's transport office|transport office]] in a desert town. It was also called home by the former [[Sith acolyte]] [[Asajj Ventress]] for a time, until she forsook her quiet life and left the object to help the [[Youngling|young]] [[Jedi]] [[Lyco Strata]] escape the Imperial forces who were [[Hunt for Lyco Strata|pursuing]] him. A [[species]] of [[Unidentified blue bird species|blue bird]] was [[Homeworld|indigenous]] to the object. ==Appearances== *{{TOTU|A Way Forward}} {{1st}} ==Sources== *{{SWYouTube|GkywNANueew|Tales of the Underworld | Official Trailer | Available May 4 on Disney+}} {{1stp}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |es=Objeto astronómico no identificado (Cort) |ka=უცნობი ასტრონომიული ობიექტი (კორტი) }} [[Category:Terrestrial astronomical objects]]
